<documents>
<document id="cushion-basic">
CushionˆonˆBasicˆCushionˆisn'tˆavailableˆonˆtheˆBasicˆplan.ˆOnˆBasic,ˆaˆdebitˆcardˆpurchaseˆlargerˆthanˆyourˆbalanceˆisˆdeclined,ˆwithˆnoˆfee.ˆ##ˆWhyˆCushionˆisˆpartˆofˆtheˆpaidˆplans.ˆIt'sˆhowˆweˆgiveˆmembersˆaˆlittleˆroomˆwithoutˆchargingˆoverdraftˆfees.ˆ##ˆGettingˆCushionˆMoveˆtoˆPlusˆforˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$50.00,ˆorˆtoˆPremiumˆforˆcoverageˆupˆtoˆ$200.ˆYou'llˆalsoˆneedˆatˆleastˆ$500ˆinˆdirectˆdepositsˆinˆtheˆlastˆ30ˆdays.ˆ##ˆOverdraftˆfeesˆBasicˆhasˆnoˆoverdraftˆfeesˆ($0.00).ˆTransactionsˆthatˆwouldˆoverdrawˆyourˆaccountˆareˆdeclinedˆinstead.ˆ##ˆCanˆaˆBasicˆbalanceˆgoˆnegative?ˆOccasionally,ˆforˆexampleˆifˆaˆmerchantˆpostsˆmoreˆthanˆitˆauthorizedˆorˆaˆdisputeˆcreditˆisˆtakenˆback.ˆAddˆmoneyˆtoˆbringˆitˆbackˆtoˆzero.ˆAnyˆdepositˆrepaysˆaˆnegativeˆbalanceˆautomatically.ˆThere'sˆnoˆfeeˆforˆaˆdeclinedˆtransaction.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-metal">
TheˆPremiumˆmetalˆcardˆPremiumˆmembersˆgetˆaˆmetalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆworksˆexactlyˆlikeˆtheˆplasticˆcard,ˆwithˆtheˆsameˆnumber,ˆlimitsˆandˆcontrols.ˆ##ˆGettingˆyourˆmetalˆcardˆWhenˆyouˆupgradeˆtoˆPremium,ˆtheˆappˆasksˆwhetherˆyouˆwantˆaˆmetalˆcardˆnowˆorˆatˆyourˆnextˆrenewal.ˆIfˆyouˆorderˆitˆnow,ˆyourˆcurrentˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆyouˆactivateˆtheˆmetalˆone.ˆ##ˆReplacingˆitˆReplacementsˆforˆaˆlost,ˆstolenˆorˆdamagedˆmetalˆcardˆareˆmetalˆandˆfreeˆonˆPremium.ˆExpeditedˆshippingˆisˆfreeˆonˆPremiumˆtoo,ˆandˆtakesˆ2ˆtoˆ3ˆbusinessˆdays.ˆ##ˆIfˆyouˆleaveˆPremiumˆYourˆmetalˆcardˆkeepsˆworkingˆuntilˆitˆexpires.ˆAfterˆthat,ˆorˆifˆyouˆneedˆaˆreplacement,ˆyou'llˆgetˆaˆplasticˆcard.ˆ##ˆDisposalˆMetalˆcardsˆcan'tˆbeˆcutˆwithˆscissors.ˆWhenˆyouˆreplaceˆone,ˆyouˆcanˆmailˆitˆbackˆtoˆusˆinˆtheˆprepaidˆenvelopeˆthatˆcomesˆwithˆtheˆnewˆcard,ˆandˆwe'llˆrecycleˆit.ˆContactlessˆworksˆonˆmetalˆcardsˆtheˆsameˆwayˆitˆdoesˆonˆplastic.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
<document id="products-business">
BusinessˆaccountsˆNo.ˆTallowbrookˆonlyˆoffersˆpersonalˆaccounts.ˆWeˆdon'tˆofferˆbusinessˆaccountsˆforˆcompanies,ˆpartnerships,ˆnonprofitsˆorˆsoleˆproprietors.ˆ##ˆUsingˆaˆpersonalˆaccountˆforˆbusinessˆPersonalˆaccountsˆareˆforˆpersonalˆuse.ˆSmallˆamountsˆofˆfreelanceˆorˆsideˆincomeˆareˆfine,ˆsuchˆasˆgettingˆpaidˆforˆoccasionalˆgigs.ˆRunningˆaˆbusiness'sˆregularˆpaymentsˆthroughˆaˆpersonalˆaccountˆisn'tˆallowed,ˆandˆcouldˆleadˆtoˆaˆreviewˆofˆyourˆaccount.ˆ##ˆBusinessˆpaymentsˆintoˆyourˆaccountˆYouˆcanˆreceiveˆpaymentsˆfromˆaˆbusiness,ˆsuchˆasˆyourˆemployerˆorˆaˆclient,ˆintoˆyourˆpersonalˆaccount.ˆ##ˆBusinessˆdebitˆcardsˆYourˆTallowbrookˆcardˆisˆaˆpersonalˆdebitˆcard.ˆItˆcan'tˆcarryˆaˆbusinessˆname.ˆ##ˆTaxˆformsˆWeˆonlyˆissueˆinterestˆtaxˆforms.ˆWeˆcan'tˆissueˆformsˆforˆbusinessˆincome.ˆ##ˆLookingˆforˆaˆbusinessˆaccount?ˆYou'llˆneedˆaˆbankˆthatˆoffersˆbusinessˆaccounts.ˆWeˆcan'tˆrecommendˆaˆspecificˆone.ˆQuestions?ˆOurˆsupportˆteamˆisˆavailableˆinˆtheˆappˆatˆanyˆhour.
</document>
</documents>
